Borough Dossiers — Fifteen Records

Pneumatic Dispatches

January 4, 1999 — Letter from Mrs. A. Vanderlyn, Fifth Avenue

Dear Chapter Secretary, we woke to find the calendar rolled back and no one will speak of the countdown. The drawing-room clock chimes thirteen. Mr. Vanderlyn wakes each night counting his breaths, as though he fears they were lent to him. The housekeeper has covered every mirror. Kindly send the usual salts. — A.V.

February 12, 1999 — Harbor Log, Narrows off Staten Island

0200: Fog bank rolled in against the tide. 0214: A shape beneath the water, longer than the steamer lanes, part hull and part hide. 0230: Lanterns on the shape went out in unison. Pilot Haskell declines to sign. Entry filed as a Rampant sighting, first of the year.

March 19, 1999 — Field Report, Jamaica Bay, Queens

Rampant observed in the marsh, shedding fumes that yellow the reeds. A local sharpshooter, a Marksman afflatus, struck it from four hundred yards in a crosswind. She collapsed afterward and aged visibly. Chapter reminder: every use of a Magica Property costs the bearer a year.

June 2, 1999 — Chapter Memorandum on the Archive

Over a million glitch sights have gone unreported across history, and the officials who learned of them executed the witnesses in private. Only fifteen archives survive, three to a borough, all of them in this house. The dossiers are not to leave the Chapter under any pretext. Burn nothing. Copy nothing.

December 3, 1999 — Pneumatic Tube Note, Wall Street to the Chapter House

Ticker tape received this morning printed a countdown in a hand not ours, and the numbers match a date we have already lived. The ley line beneath the Exchange hums at night. Three partners have withdrawn to the club. The Exchange has declared a recess for “mechanical reasons.”

December 21, 1999 — Letter from the Dowager Mrs. Pell-Whitcombe, Brooklyn Heights

My dear, the garden has bloomed in midwinter and every flower faces the river. Last night something large crossed the water and the gulls fell silent. The Rampants have not yet come to the Heights, but the roses know. I have taken to dining early. Do burn this after reading.

Lore Codex — The Glitch & the Archive

I. The Glitch Sights

Across history, sightings of magical abilities have spread far across the land: a hand that stilled a storm, a voice that bent a crowd, a lantern that burned without oil. Each appearance was met with the same answer. Those affiliated were privately executed, and officials quickly dismissed the matter as rumor, drunkenness or hysteria.

The Chapter holds that over a million of these “glitch sights” were never reported at all. Of all that silence, only fifteen archives were ever recovered: the fifteen Borough Dossiers, three for each of the five boroughs, kept here under seal.

II. The Countdown

On the day of the countdown to the 21st century, a glitch from a ley line beneath Manhattan burst. Toxic fumes spread from the wound, and wicked kaiju circled across the world, killing all life in a matter of minutes.

Now the survivors wake in the year 1999. Time has reverted itself backward. The glitch ley lines that granted humans their magic, and that released the fumes into the atmosphere, have cracked, and from the cracks are born amalgamations known as “Rampants.” They terrorize the rural reaches of New York City, and they may bleed out into the rest of the world, repeating another death cycle unless they are stopped.

III. Glossary of the Arcanum

AFFLATUSThe element of a Borough Dossier. It is the nature of the magic that moves through its bearer, and each borough leans toward one: Manhattan toward Space, Brooklyn toward Foliage, Queens toward Marksman, the Bronx toward the Otherworldly, and Staten Island toward Sediment. A record’s own afflatus may differ from its borough’s dominant one.
MAGICA PROPERTYA magical ability awarded to Borough Dossiers who stood near glitch sights across history. Every property carries the same drawback: each use ticks one year off the user’s life. Some, like Whisper, add further costs, such as nausea and short-term memory loss, and scale with how long they are used.
MAGICA MEDIUMThe object through which a bearer channels their property, such as a pocket watch, a violin or an umbrella.
RAMPANTSCorrupted kaiju leaking from the glitch ley lines after time reverted itself backwards. They are amalgamations: part beast, part wreckage, part whatever the fumes touched. They gather in the rural reaches of the city, and the Chapter’s chief fear is that they will bleed out to the rest of the world.
THE GLITCH LEY LINESThe fractured currents beneath the city that once gave humankind its magic. The Manhattan line burst on the day of the countdown, and the others are cracking now.
